description: Read saved Outreach contacts: cited pages with their status, author, email and where the email came from, LinkedIn, contact page, and pitch draft. Only pages someone has triaged, enriched or drafted are listed; find other cited pages with the source-page analytics tools. Newest first; use offset for the next page. Read-only.

statuses.description: Only contacts in these statuses. Omit for all.

items.description: Pipeline status. "New" means untriaged; "Rejected" removes the page from the active queue.

url.description: Return only this page's contact. Omit to list all.

name: list_outreach_contacts

email_source.description: Where the email came from: page_author (published on the page and matches the author), page_contact (the site's own address, may not reach the author), hunter (Hunter.io match, not published on the page, check before sending), manual (entered by a person). Null when unknown.

page_emails.description: Up to five addresses the page or its linked contact page publishes, the chosen one first. Not a complete inventory.
